mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO quote_tick (stock_code, trade_date, traded_at, price, volume, acc_volume, change_rate, trade_side, received_at) VALUES
(#{t.stockCode}, #{t.tradeDate}, #{t.tradedAt}, #{t.price}, #{t.volume}, #{t.accVolume}, #{t.changeRate}, #{t.tradeSide}, #{t.receivedAt})

INSERT INTO quote_snapshot (stock_code, price, change_sign, change_amount, change_rate, open_price, high_price, low_price, acc_volume, acc_amount, trade_date, traded_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{t.stockCode}, #{t.price}, #{t.changeSign}, #{t.changeAmount}, #{t.changeRate}, #{t.open}, #{t.high}, #{t.low}, #{t.accVolume}, #{t.accAmount}, #{t.tradeDate}, #{t.tradedAt}, #{now})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE price = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(price), price), change_sign = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(change_sign), change_sign), change_amount = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(change_amount), change_amount), change_rate = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(change_rate), change_rate), open_price = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(open_price), open_price), high_price = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(high_price), high_price), low_price = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(low_price), low_price), acc_amount = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(acc_amount), acc_amount), traded_at = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(traded_at), traded_at), updated_at = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), trade_date = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(trade_date), trade_date), acc_volume = IF(VALUES(acc_volume) >= acc_volume OR VALUES(trade_date) > trade_date, VALUES(acc_volume), acc_volume)
INSERT INTO quote_quarantine (raw, reason, received_at) VALUES (#{raw}, #{reason}, #{receivedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT stock_code, price, change_sign, change_amount, change_rate, open_price, high_price, low_price, acc_volume, traded_at, updated_at FROM quote_snapshot WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}
SELECT stock_code, price, change_sign, change_amount, change_rate, open_price, high_price, low_price, acc_volume, traded_at, updated_at FROM quote_snapshot WHERE stock_code IN #{c}
SELECT trade_date, COUNT(*) AS tick_count, MIN(traded_at) AS first_at, MAX(traded_at) AS last_at FROM quote_tick WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} GROUP BY trade_date ORDER BY trade_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quote_tick WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode} AND trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND traded_at >= #{from}

SELECT t.stock_code, i.stock_name, COUNT(*) AS tick_count, SUM(t.volume) AS saved_volume, MIN(t.acc_volume) AS first_acc, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(t.volume ORDER BY t.acc_volume), ',', 1) AS UNSIGNED) AS first_volume, MAX(t.acc_volume) AS last_acc, MIN(t.traded_at) AS first_at, MAX(t.traded_at) AS last_at, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, t.traded_at, t.received_at)) / 1000) AS avg_delay_ms, ROUND(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, t.traded_at, t.received_at)) / 1000) AS max_delay_ms FROM quote_tick t JOIN stock_info i ON i.stock_code = t.stock_code WHERE t.trade_date = #{tradeDate} GROUP BY t.stock_code, i.stock_name ORDER BY tick_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quote_tick WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate}

SELECT DATE(a.published_at) AS day, a.article_id, a.title, a.source_type, a.press, a.published_at, s.relevance FROM article_stock s JOIN article a ON a.article_id = s.article_id WHERE s.stock_code = #{stockCode} AND a.status = 'DONE' AND DATE(a.published_at) IN #{d} ORDER BY day, s.relevance IS NULL, s.relevance DESC, a.published_at DESC
